evaluation.design: Fixed preseason holdout; no holdout games used to fit coefficients. Hyperparameters fixed in code; not tuned on holdout.
evaluation.probability_note: Logistic probabilities and empirical 80% ranges are calibrated on the preceding season, then evaluated on this separate holdout. Ties are excluded from binary metrics.
